name: Capacity booked against permitted
definition: Tons booked in the quarter as a share of the unit's capacity for the quarter (permitted tons a year divided by 52, times the weeks), by facility and unit.
sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.booked_tons) AS booked, SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS capacity, SUM(b.booked_tons) / SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS share
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week BETWEEN 40 AND 52
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY share DESC

name: Unit headroom for a period
definition: Capacity minus booked tons for the weeks in the period, by facility and unit.
sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.capacity_tons - b.booked_tons) AS headroom_tons
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week IN (45, 46) AND NOT b.outage
GROUP BY 1, 2

name: Permitted outlets for a stream
definition: Units at which every waste code on the profile is permitted and the physical form is accepted; with capacity in the period, an outlet.
sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

name: Full cost a ton by route
definition: Treatment cost plus handling plus the receiving state's fee plus the transport lane from the origin region, a ton, for a stream at a unit.
sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code, t.cost_usd_ton + p.handling_usd_ton + f.fee_usd_ton + l.rate_usd_ton AS full_cost_usd_ton
FROM ops.process_unit u
JOIN fin.treatment_cost t USING (facility_code, process_code)
JOIN fin.price_book p USING (process_code)
JOIN ops.facility fa USING (facility_code)
JOIN fin.state_fee f ON f.state = fa.state AND f.valid_to IS NULL
JOIN fin.transport_lane l ON l.facility_code = u.facility_code AND l.origin_region = :origin

name: Margin a ton by stream and route
definition: Price a ton minus full cost a ton, as a share of price, for a stream at its quoted route.
sql:
SELECT q.profile_id, q.facility_code, q.process_code, q.price_usd_ton, (q.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / q.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM fin.quote_line q
JOIN full_cost fc USING (facility_code, process_code)

name: Contract margin on full cost
definition: Revenue minus full cost over all a generator's streams, as a share of revenue, against the 28% floor.
sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, SUM(i.full_cost_usd) AS full_cost, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
WHERE i.invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY i.generator_id
HAVING margin_pct < 0.28

name: Streams below the stream floor
definition: Approved profiles whose margin a ton at the approved route, at today's fees, is below 15%.
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.price_usd_ton, fc.full_cost_usd_ton, (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN full_cost fc ON fc.facility_code = p.facility_code AND fc.process_code = p.process_code AND fc.origin_region = (SELECT origin_region FROM ops.generator g WHERE g.generator_id = p.generator_id)
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton < 0.15

name: Revenue against plan
definition: Invoiced revenue by business and month against the FY26 plan for the same months.
sql:
SELECT i.business_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS period, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, ANY_VALUE(r.plan_usd) AS plan
FROM fin.invoice_line i
JOIN fin.revenue_plan r ON r.business_code = i.business_code AND r.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2

name: Margin by facility and unit
definition: Revenue minus full cost as a share of revenue, by facility and unit, from invoice lines.
sql:
SELECT i.facility_code, i.process_code, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY margin_pct

name: Profiles pending approval
definition: Profiles in status Pending, with days since receipt and whether a laboratory result is released.
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.received_on, DAY) AS days_pending, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.profile_analytical a WHERE a.profile_id = p.profile_id AND a.released_on IS NOT NULL) AS result_released
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Pending'

name: Profiles expiring in 90 days
definition: Approved profiles whose expiry falls in the next 90 days, with tons a year and revenue at risk.
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.expires_on, p.annual_tons * p.price_usd_ton AS annual_revenue
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND p.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

name: Profile approval cycle time
definition: Days from profile receipt to approval, median and 90th percentile, by quarter.
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(p.approved_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(p.approved_on, p.received_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.approved_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

name: Profiles approved before the result was released
definition: Approved profiles whose approval date precedes the release of their laboratory result.
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.approved_on, MIN(a.released_on) AS first_release
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN ops.profile_analytical a USING (profile_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING p.approved_on < first_release

name: Off-spec rate by generator
definition: Receipt discrepancies as a share of received manifests, by generator, this year.
sql:
SELECT m.generator_id, COUNTIF(m.off_spec) / COUNT(*) AS off_spec_rate, COUNT(*) AS receipts
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING receipts >= 20
ORDER BY off_spec_rate DESC

name: Ten-day transfer exceedances
definition: Shipments that stayed at a service center more than ten days, by center and month.
sql:
SELECT h.center_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', h.arrived_on) AS month, COUNTIF(h.exceeded_ten_days) AS exceeded, COUNT(*) AS holds
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
GROUP BY 1, 2

name: Shipments on the pad against their clock
definition: Shipments still at a service center with days held and the tenth-day deadline.
sql:
SELECT h.manifest_id, h.center_code, h.arrived_on, h.days_held, h.deadline
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
WHERE h.left_on IS NULL
ORDER BY h.deadline

name: Manifests without an in-capacity outlet
definition: Open manifests booked to a unit that is down or over capacity in the week of arrival.
sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.generator_id, m.facility_code, m.process_code, m.tons, m.eta
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND (b.outage OR b.booked_tons > b.capacity_tons)

name: Re-route cost on the rate card
definition: For a manifest, the full cost at an alternative unit minus the full cost at the booked unit, times tons.
sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, (fc_alt.full_cost_usd_ton - fc_now.full_cost_usd_ton) * m.tons AS extra_cost_usd
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN full_cost fc_now ON fc_now.facility_code = m.facility_code AND fc_now.process_code = m.process_code
JOIN full_cost fc_alt ON fc_alt.facility_code = :alt_facility AND fc_alt.process_code = m.process_code

name: Third-party outlet spend
definition: Tons and outlet cost sent to third-party outlets this year, by outlet.
sql:
SELECT t.outlet_id, SUM(t.tons) AS tons, SUM(t.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM ops.third_party_manifest t
GROUP BY 1

name: Third-party approvals expiring
definition: Profile approvals at third-party outlets expiring in the next 60 days, with the streams that depend on them.
sql:
SELECT a.outlet_id, a.profile_id, a.generator_id, a.expires_on, a.cost_usd_ton
FROM ops.third_party_approval a
WHERE a.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)

name: Profiles on the legacy system
definition: Profiles still in LegacyTrack, by source company, and how many an Approval Chemist has reviewed.
sql:
SELECT l.source_company, COUNT(*) AS profiles, COUNTIF(l.reviewed) AS reviewed
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
GROUP BY 1

name: Legacy price against the price book
definition: The acquired companies' price a ton against the 2026 price book for the same process, by profile.
sql:
SELECT l.ironbridge_profile_id, l.legacy_price_usd_ton, b.price_usd_ton AS book, l.legacy_price_usd_ton / b.price_usd_ton - 1 AS gap
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
JOIN ops.waste_profile p ON p.profile_id = l.ironbridge_profile_id
JOIN fin.price_book b ON b.process_code = p.process_code

name: Quote turnaround
definition: Days from request to issue by quarter, and quotes issued after the date the customer asked for.
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(q.issued_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, AVG(q.turnaround_days) AS avg_days, COUNTIF(q.issued_on > q.due_on) AS late
FROM fin.quote q
WHERE q.issued_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

name: Quote win rate
definition: Quotes won as a share of quotes decided, by quarter and account manager.
sql:
SELECT q.owner, COUNTIF(q.status = 'Won') / COUNTIF(q.status IN ('Won', 'Lost')) AS win_rate
FROM fin.quote q
GROUP BY 1

name: Quoted price against the price book
definition: Quote lines priced below the price book, with the discount and who approved it.
sql:
SELECT ql.quote_id, ql.profile_id, ql.price_usd_ton, ql.book_price_usd_ton, 1 - ql.price_usd_ton / ql.book_price_usd_ton AS discount
FROM fin.quote_line ql
WHERE ql.price_usd_ton < ql.book_price_usd_ton

name: Tons by waste code
definition: Tons received this year by waste code and receiving unit.
sql:
SELECT c AS waste_code, m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.waste_profile p USING (profile_id), UNNEST(SPLIT(p.waste_codes, ',')) c
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

name: State fee exposure
definition: Tons received by state and the fee change from 1 November, split by contracts with and without the pass-through clause.
sql:
SELECT fa.state, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(f_new.fee_usd_ton - f_old.fee_usd_ton) AS fee_change
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.facility fa USING (facility_code)
JOIN fin.state_fee f_old ON f_old.state = fa.state AND f_old.valid_to IS NOT NULL
JOIN fin.state_fee f_new ON f_new.state = fa.state AND f_new.valid_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 1

name: Permits and approvals up for renewal
definition: Facilities with a permit renewal pending and third-party outlets with an approval expiring in 90 days.
sql:
SELECT 'facility' AS kind, f.facility_code AS id, f.unit_note AS note FROM ops.process_unit f WHERE f.unit_note LIKE '%renewal%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'outlet', t.outlet_id, CAST(t.approval_expires_on AS STRING) FROM ops.third_party_outlet t WHERE t.approval_expires_on <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

name: Tons and revenue stranded by an outage
definition: Open manifests booked to a unit in outage weeks: tons and revenue.
sql:
SELECT m.facility_code, COUNT(*) AS manifests, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, SUM(m.revenue_usd) AS revenue
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND b.outage
GROUP BY 1

name: Revenue by generator
definition: Invoiced revenue and margin by generator this year.
sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC

name: Tons by transport lane
definition: Tons received by origin region and facility, with the lane rate and loaded miles.
sql:
SELECT g.origin_region, m.facility_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(l.rate_usd_ton) AS rate, ANY_VALUE(l.loaded_miles) AS miles
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.generator g USING (generator_id)
JOIN fin.transport_lane l ON l.origin_region = g.origin_region AND l.facility_code = m.facility_code
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

name: Aerosol and cylinder volume
definition: Tons received at Cypress Landing since it opened, by unit, against its permitted capacity.
sql:
SELECT m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.facility_code = 'CYP' AND m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1

name: Stabilized output against the LDR standard
definition: Stabilized batches shipped to Millhaven with the treatment standard result on file.
sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.tons
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.facility_code = 'MLN' AND m.status = 'Received'

name: Days from sample to released result
definition: Days from sample to release, median by month; profiles waiting on a result.
sql:
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', a.sampled_on) AS month, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(a.released_on, a.sampled_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.profile_analytical a
GROUP BY 1
